svg.title: Security system block diagram with keypad, BCD encoder, shift registers, comparator, one-shots and alarm
svg.desc: Keypad Key(0) to Key(9) feed a decimal-to-BCD encoder and an OR gate, together with Enter. BCD output goes to four-bit shift register A. A code selection logic block feeds four-bit shift register B. Both registers go to a four-bit magnitude comparator whose EQ output is MagCompare, feeding ShiftIn of the code selection logic and S_L of the eight-bit shift register C. The OR gate output enables One-Shot A, whose TimeoutA clocks registers A and B and enables One-Shot B. TimeoutB clocks shift register C, which is loaded with hard-coded value 00010000 and outputs Alarm.
